sources.title: Fixed-weight block contrast, shift invariance and bootstrap composition examples
sources.author: Causal banking proposal project
supported_claims: Supplied unit/time weights yield 11/2 dollars and stipulated net 3/2.
Weights summing to 3/4 allow a common 100-dollar post shock to change contrast by 25 dollars; valid unit-sum weights cancel it.
Two controls and two treated units give homogeneous-bootstrap composition probability 1/8 and 8/7 expected draws per admissible composition.
Weights 3/4 and 1/4 give effective donor count 8/5.
